detail.longDescription: Can't believe that a personal project of mine has 65 stars, 16 forks, and has received PRs from 8 people (other than me), with over 400 downloads of the latest version! I really only started working on beansprout because river was introducing the river window management protocol and it seemed like something fun to do and a way for me to change a few personal preferences that didn't exist in the river-classic wm, but the fact other people are actually using it is wild to me! #RiverCompositor #Wayland #Programming (It did also help get me a job when the hiring manager saw I was working on it on my résumé))
